supporting_pages.title: "Deploy an agentic AI application on GKE with the Agent Development Kit (ADK)\
evidence_snippets: Learn how to use Cloud Logging and Cloud Monitoring to gain insights into your agent's performance and health within your GKE cluster.

Forward the agent's service to your local machine : The adk-agent service is of type NodePort , but the most direct way to access it from your Cloud Shell environment is to use the kubectl port-forward command.
The ADK agent application runs on a standard CPU node pool and the self-hosted LLM (Llama 3.1 on vLLM) runs on a GPU-enabled node pool, both within the same GKE cluster.
